title: ALIGNED AGENTS, BIASED SWARM: MEASURING BIAS AMPLIFICATION IN MULTI-AGENT SYSTEMS
reasoning: The paper investigates bias as an emergent property of multi-agent systems, framing the study within the context of 'ethical robustness'. It evaluates high-stakes scenarios involving ethical trade-offs, such as kidney transplant prioritization and visa application approvals, to measure how social prejudices propagate and amplify through communicative graphs.
